text: A high-angle view of a lab bench area. Centre: a dark grey rack with multiple circular holes mounted on a white 3D-printed stand over an aluminium extrusion rail; the holes appear empty, with a teal/green tab on its right edge. A small printed marker (checkerboard/AprilTag pattern) sits on a plate behind it. Right of the rack: a white device with a black knob and small display, with white tubing and cables running down. Far right: a blue vacuum-pump-like machine, a black vertical post with clamps on a metal frame, a red-capped bottle, and a grey extrusion beam. Foreground bottom: white trays, one holding a stained dish and a white cylindrical container, plus black cables and dark rectangular blocks.
